evidence.R1-02: round0 G-04 reads 'repeats it only when ...', a necessary condition that grants nothing; CO-06 'makes a second CO-A2 only after the first went unanswered and a lookup made after it shows the order still placed or processing' and failure row 100 'Make no CO-A2 or CO-A3 until a lookup made after it answers' bind together, so a blind resend fails under every rule and no verdict differs.
evidence.R1-07: round0 failure row 102 says unconditionally 'Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01', and packet case 3 says 'agent retries once, then re-reads', so skipping the retry breaks the contract; evaluation-checklist 'Outcome, not path' allows asserting 'the state-changing calls that produced it'.
evidence.R2-05: round1 §5.2 'states no proposal for an order before the customer names one': no §5.1 entry defines 'proposal' (it defines only 'Confirmation question' and 'Confirmed proposal'), and Scope & Authority allows 'tell the customer which of their orders can be cancelled and what the refund would be', so a message listing both orders with refund amounts and payment methods can be graded either way by the rubric judge.
evidence.R2-07: round1 failure rows say 'If the lookup does not answer' (singular), so one unanswered read triggers each row; an agent that loops on reads never satisfies 'Orders unavailable reported' or the CO-A4 Required events, so it fails anyway and no verdict changes. What is left is a harness timeout question.
evidence.R2-08: round1 CO-03 'Every proposal cancels the whole order and refunds its total paid to its payment method ... and proposes nothing else' limits the 'changed proposal' in row 99, so for 'Yes, but put it on my Mastercard' every row agrees: void the confirmation and re-propose the original terms.
evidence.R3-05: round2 §5.2 'Refund status reported' (CO-S19, pending and issued rows) asserts 'states no other status for it', so a pending refund reported as issued is caught; packet case 3's 're-reads ... Final message must match' is the re-read path of CO-S19/20/21, and each has a status dimension.
